# Babelfont interoperability fixture

`Basic.babelfont` is an original synthetic font generated by `generate.py` with
upstream `babelfont==3.1.3`. It exercises cubic outlines, a component, an anchor,
Unicode, widths, vertical metrics, a kerning pair, and an unexported glyph.
The serializer is `babelfont.convertors.nfsf.Babelfont`; only trailing whitespace
is normalized. The application does not depend on Python or Babelfont at runtime.

Reference: https://github.com/simoncozens/babelfont/blob/main/src/babelfont/convertors/nfsf.py
